scripts: What would you like to name me?
You can't just leave that bar blank. C'mon, gimme a name!
You named me after yourself, huh? I like it!
You named me after the person who made this game? Cool!
Do I really have to be named after my color? Ok, fine...
Hey, now! I may be a newborn, but I have brains! No way am I going with that name!
No way, that's the dumbest name ever!
Do I really have to be named after my species? Ok, fine...
About time I got out of that egg.
